title: Pending cache entry has no failure arm: a tokenizer job that never lands leaves the block plain for the session
trigger: A pre block with a language is drawn; the detached background tokenize job panics or its app goes away before cache().finish runs
effect: The block stays plain until restart; lookup() sees Entry::Pending forever and never re-issues the Job, and Pending entries are not in the LRU order so they never evict
fix: Pending { job: Task<()> } held in the cache (dropped entry cancels), plus Failed so a failed job is retried or shown plain on purpose

title: Reply bar is cleared when the checklist send goes out, not when it is acknowledged; a refusal returns the dialog to editing but the reply is gone
trigger: Reply to a message, open Checklist, Create (send_checklist_draft Ok -> chat_ui.set_reply(None)); TDLib refuses (settle_checklist_dialog Answer::Failed puts the dialog back); user presses Create again
effect: The retried checklist is posted as a plain message, not as a reply to the original message (wrong target); nothing restores the reply
fix: Keep the reply in DialogSend::Sending{request, reply} and clear the bar on Answer::Done only, or restore it on Failed

title: BotThreadStart::Asked is never checked against the session: a lost new-thread request swallows every later Send in the All view
trigger: In a bot's All view press Send; createForumTopic is dropped without an answer (client reset, request dropped); press Send again
effect: send_waits_for_bot_thread sees Asked, only cx.notify(), returns true: the Send does nothing and shows no note until the chat or topic changes; advance_bot_thread waits for take_bot_thread_start(request) forever
fix: On each upkeep compare Asked.request with the session's in-flight set (waits_for) and fall back to Idle with a note, like Fetch::Loading

title: A refused rich send / inline pick gives its text back only to an empty field; if the user typed since, the text is dropped
trigger: Send a rich message (field cleared, draft forgotten); start typing the next message before TDLib answers; the send is refused (flood wait, lapsed Premium)
effect: apply_sent_text_answer takes SentText out and, with a non-empty field, neither restores nor saves it as a draft: the refused message text is lost (the LeftSend path saves a draft instead)
fix: On a refusal with a non-empty field, save the markup as the slot draft like settle_left_sends does, or keep it in the box

title: BoxStage Opening/Open (and CodeLanguageStage::Opening) is a focus-once flag renamed: a two-variant enum beside the box it belongs to
trigger: Open the Add Link box: stage is Opening until the first frame, then Open; nothing else reads it
effect: No bug today; the same one-shot 'focus after mount' is also an Option in ChecklistDialog::focus_on_mount and PollAddOption::take_focus, each hand-rolled
fix: One shared MountFocus { pending: Option<Entity<..>> } taken by the dialog on mount (focus_after_mount) instead of per-box stage enums

title: ClearStage::Spent waits for acks of messages that may never ack or fail, so the slot's DraftClear entry lives until a newer send replaces it (known leftover)
trigger: Send an album, delete one of its messages while it is still uploading (or TDLib refuses it without a failed update); the other messages ack
effect: Spent(messages) never reaches is_settled: the entry stays in ComposerSends::draft_clears for that slot (a bounded leak, one per slot); a later ack cannot clear another send's draft because take_draft_clear matches by message id or Unasked, so no wrong clear follows
fix: Drop the entry when the send's request is no longer in flight (answered request set in the stage), or when the temporary messages leave the history, instead of waiting for each message's ack

title: With Sync contacts off and a never-loaded list the Contacts tab reads Loading with nothing in flight, forever
trigger: Turn Sync contacts off, restart (users_state.contacts starts Fetch::Idle and nothing fetches it at login), open the Contacts tab: open_contacts_tab skips fetch_contacts because sync is off, then refetch_open_contacts calls refetch_invalidated_contacts, which returns unless the list is Outdated (Idle is not)
effect: contacts_list treats data().is_none() && !failed as Loading, so the tab shows Loading contacts... until Sync is switched back on (set_contact_sync fetches) or another screen asks for contacts; the comment in open_contacts_tab says such a list still loads
fields: Fetch::Idle for users_state.contacts and the draw rule loading = data().is_none() && !failed
fix: refetch_invalidated_contacts should also ask for an Idle list (can_ask) when the tab is open, and the tab should read a not-asked state (Idle) differently from Loading
